guarantees.claim: u_prim_state_done_muxed connects in_i to {state_done_muxed[1], state_done_muxed[0]} and out_o to {state_done_buf[1], state_done_buf[0]}, driving these nets structurally.

assumptions.claim: NumShares must be >= 2, otherwise indices [1] and [0] are out of bounds.
assumptions.cond: when the design is elaborated with NumShares < 2
assumptions.risk: synthesis error or out-of-bound access leading to undefined RTL behavior.

assumptions.claim: The param Width = 128 * NumShares must equal the bit width of the concatenated in_i and out_o expressions (256 bits when NumShares=2).
assumptions.cond: when NumShares has a value not equal to 2
assumptions.risk: width mismatch causing Verilog truncation/padding, potentially wrong buffer connection and data corruption.

uncertain_points.claim: When NumShares > 2, out_o of prim_buf has width 128*NumShares but only the lower 256 bits (shares 0 and 1) are connected; the MSBs are floating.
uncertain_points.risk: Undriven nets may propagate X in simulation, mask missing high-share data, and break masked security if those shares are expected.

uncertain_points.claim: state_done_buf is declared with NumShares elements but only elements 0 and 1 are driven by this instance; elements 2..NumShares-1 are undriven.
uncertain_points.risk: Undriven array elements may cause simulation X's, indicate missing drivers, and create a silent security gap if higher shares are used elsewhere.
